title: Screamline Park
premise: Summer interns keep a chaotic theme park running: broken rides, ride-height rules, prize booths and a raccoon who steals funnel cake.

companion.name: BANDIT
companion.about: a raccoon who steals funnel cake and somehow always knows the rules; talks only in the interns' imaginations, so his lines are thoughts

cast.RAFI: ride tech; fixes anything, talks to machines
cast.HANA: booth boss; runs the prize booths, competitive
cast.GUS: mascot costume kid; always stuck in the mascot head
cast.ODALYS: park reporter; writes the daily park news, asks hard questions
cast.MR. KRANK: the grumpy park manager; loves rules, hates refunds

gag: Gus is always stuck in the mascot head.

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, bright candy red, turquoise and sunny yellow palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.rafi: a boy age 11 with medium brown skin, short wavy black hair, a red staff polo shirt and a tool belt with a big wrench
fragments.hana: a girl age 11 with light skin, a high black ponytail, a red staff polo shirt and a whistle on a lanyard
fragments.gus: a boy age 11 with pale skin and freckles wearing a fuzzy orange mascot costume body with the huge round grinning mascot head on top
fragments.odalys: a girl age 11 with dark brown skin, curly hair in a puff, a red staff polo shirt, a notepad and a pencil behind her ear
fragments.bandit: a chubby gray raccoon with a black mask face and a striped tail, holding a piece of funnel cake
fragments.krank: a tall thin grumpy man with a gray mustache, a dark green park manager blazer, a striped tie, a visor cap and a clipboard
fragments.park: a sunny theme park with candy-striped roller coasters, a carousel, prize booths and twinkling string lights
